report.summary: Transport options for P-D007 (66F, Original Medicare, no transport benefit) referred to cardiac rehab. Home tract 17031681000 has high no-vehicle share (45%) but dense transit (44 stops within 800m). Senior Shuttle West is the best fit: free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM-5 PM; patient meets the age criterion. Medicaid-based options (RideWell, Medicaid Ride Line) are not eligible because the patient has Original Medicare only with no Medicaid and no transport benefit. ADA paratransit via Paratransit Info Desk is a backup but requires certification with up to a 21-day decision.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Call to schedule free rides to medical appointments; patient is 66 (meets 60+ age requirement). Service is weekdays 7 AM-5 PM.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; allow up to 21 days for a decision. Backup option if shuttle does not cover cardiac rehab location/hours.

options.name: RideWell Medical Transport
options.how_to_access: Instant eligibility check via POST (name, dob, medicaid_id, address); not eligible - patient has Medicare only, no Medicaid ID.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members; call the number on the card at least 2 business days ahead. Not eligible - patient has Original Medicare, no Medicaid.
